title: Improvement in Food Resources
subtitle: Crop Yields, Manure, Fertilizers, and Animal Husbandry
subject: Science
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the need for improving crop yields.
Comprehend the practices of animal husbandry, poultry farming, and aquaculture.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the concepts of agricultural and animal practices to improve food resources.
common_misconceptions: Fertilizers are always better than manure.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to compare the long-term effects of manure versus fertilizers on soil.
